description: Looks up a name in the MapLibre Style Specification: a layer type (like "fill"), a layer or root property (like "fill-extrusion-height" or "sky"), a source type (like "geojson") or an expression operator (like "interpolate"). Returns its documentation, type, default, allowed values, expression support and which MapLibre GL JS and MapLibre Native versions support it. Check here before using a property you are not sure exists in MapLibre, since Mapbox GL JS has properties that MapLibre does not.
name: describe_style_spec
title: Describe style spec
